subject: Data description entry
notes: kb/Work PB1650 (wave 1019 D2). SR21 ('The PROPERTY clause shall not be specified in the same data description entry as: a) a BASED clause, b) a TYPEDEF clause.', cite.py OK 21)) is the clause-placement table's NotWith row for a WRITTEN clause (COBOL2333), and ScreenComposedBased asks a) of a BASED clause a TYPE clause composes (§13.18.57.4 GR1, 'as though the data description identified by type-name-1 had been coded in place'; COBOL2510): `01 T TYPEDEF BASED PIC X(4). 01 P TYPE T PROPERTY.` in a class's object storage used to compile. b) cannot be composed: a TYPE copy never makes its subject a type declaration. The legal TYPE + PROPERTY spelling (SR14 admits it) is pb1650_property_typed. The code-location no longer names OoBindPropertyClauses, which holds no SR21 arm. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.Oo.cs#OoBindPropertyClauses (OoBindPropertyClauses holds no SR21 arm since kb/Work PB1273 moved the written arm to the clause-placement table; the composed arm is ScreenComposedBased (kb/Work PB1650))
